title: Quadratic Boolean function under sign encoding
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, evaluate the complete quadratic Boolean function on the sign vector obtained by encoding each coordinate of $x$ as $(-1)^{x_i}$. The result is the sign encoding of the complete quadratic bit of $x$.
